name: pyhouse-git
description: Repository workflow commands, independent of language and of any architecture. Ships /commit, which reviews what is about to be staged, then writes a Conventional Commits 1.0.0 message whose type carries the release the change earns — feat for a minor, fix for a patch, BREAKING CHANGE for a major — so a version can be read off the history instead of argued at release time, and /install-commit-hook, which puts a commit-msg hook in the repository so a malformed message is refused at commit time. Depends on nothing and is installed on its own.
